build.//: Override of the `build` target inferred by @nx/js/typescript (see that plugin's registration in nx.json for why the inferred `tsc --build tsconfig.lib.json` cannot run in this workspace). The `drizzle/**/*` asset glob is covered by the inferred `assets` target.

test.//: Override of the inferred `test` target (dependsOn only; executor/cache/outputs come from inference). compile-cli*.test.ts spawn the BUILT bin at {projectRoot}/dist/src/cli/compile.js and assert the migration folders exist at {projectRoot}/dist/drizzle — under this workspace's remodel that asset glob is owned by the inferred `assets` target (main's `@nx/js:tsc` `build` copied it inline). targetDefaults.test's `^build` builds only DEPENDENCIES, never this project's OWN dist/ or assets, so `build` + `assets` are declared. `lint`/`^build` repeated because an explicit dependsOn replaces the targetDefault.

typecheck-spec.//: Type-checks the SPEC corpus (packages/agent/agent-engine-compiler/tsconfig.spec.json). Closes lane-reachability rule 6 / backlog 770c0919: a tsconfig.spec.json with no compiling target lets the spec corpus carry type errors no gate can see. The ratchet baselines the pre-existing spec errors in tools/nx-plugins/build/executors/typecheck-spec/agent-engine-compiler.baseline.json (baselined, NOT excluded) and fails on any per-file increase or on include narrowing. Wired into test.dependsOn so nx affected -t test runs it.

e2e.//: Subprocess / real-server lane (backlog 5b839b90 AC1; docs/decisions/0009-test-lanes-unit-vs-e2e.md). Runs ONLY src/**/*.e2e.ts and src/**/*.e2e.test.ts via vitest.e2e.config.ts; the unit `test` target excludes those files. Reached by the push/CI gate (`nx affected -t e2e --parallel=1`, tools/vite-plugins/e2e-globs.mjs + tools/gate/lane-gate.mjs) and by `publish`/`nx-release-publish`. Its own pipeline stage, never in `nx test`; not env-gated. Cached on content (`cache:true` + inputs); declares no outputs so it never restores over dist/. dependsOn mirrors the artifacts the spawned children execute (built dist of this project and its dependencies).
